title: ExplorerDependenciesScreen
responsibility: Shows direct project dependency declarations from the selected revision

inputs.name: host
inputs.description: Selected revision, package catalog, navigation scope and shared explorer services. Older revisions may have no dependency inventory.

outputs.name: ExplorerDependenciesScreen
outputs.description: Searchable direct package declarations grouped by ecosystem, with version requirements, dependency types, declaring workspaces and explicit unavailable-data messages.
